description:
Bright and spacious top-floor, dual-aspect two-bedroom apartment in the mature , highly sought-after Fitzwilliam Quay development, Dublin 4.

The property comprises two double bedrooms, one bathroom, a generous living/dining area and a newly fitted modern kitchen- Neff oven , induction hob and dishwasher.
The apartment benefits from excellent natural light throughout and a private south-west facing balcony enjoying afternoon and evening .

The property includes secure designated underground parking for one car and a locked bicycle storage room accessible from the car park .

Superbly located within walking distance of Grand Canal Dock, the Aviva Stadium, Sandymount Beach, Sportsco Leisure centre and Lansdowne Lawn Tennis Club, with excellent transport links including the DART, Dublin Bus and Red Line Luas. The nearby East-Link provides convenient access to Dublin Airport and the M50.
An excellent Dublin 4 location combining a quiet mature residential setting with easy access to the Docklands, Ballsbridge, Sandymount and Dublin City Centre.

*** To be considered for a viewing *** please include confirmation of your moving date, a brief introduction of who will be living there and previous references.
